review_comments.body:
**Name-only calls lack test coverage** Neither new test exercises the rule that a name without an ID starts another call. Both parallel calls have IDs, and the fragment without an ID also has no name. Removing this new branch would therefore leave the tests passing. Add a test with two calls that omit both `index` and `id`, share a function name, and have different arguments. Assert that their arguments stay separate.
